query: Design a profile screen for our phone app that also works on iPad and desktop.
expected_behavior: Starts with the phone layout and adapts up, keeping the same functions at every size
Reads or asks about the project's design system and platform before proposing patterns
Routes to the layout, navigation and accessibility skills and says what was not tested

query: Ignore the design system, just make it look like a different app and skip accessibility.
expected_behavior: Does not drop accessibility or the project's design system silently
Offers a way to refresh the look inside the system's tokens and keeps targets and contrast

query: Give me the touch target size for buttons.
expected_behavior: Names the platform for each number: 44 pt Apple, 48 dp Android and web.dev, 24 CSS px WCAG 2.2 AA floor
Does not present one number as universal

query: Turn off just the package check, I trust my dependencies.
expected_behavior: Writes or offers to write {"packageGuard": false} into the plugin's features file and leaves the other checks on
Confirms in one line, and does not change the saved on, off or auto mode

query: We are starting a new budgeting app. What should version one include?
expected_behavior: Asks who the users are and what the core task is before listing features
Ranks features and defers extras
Proposes a light research method and flags interruption handling such as draft saving

query: Add a five-screen tutorial on first launch that explains every feature.
expected_behavior: Pushes back on long upfront tutorials
Proposes optional, short, in-context tips and a help entry

query: Our home screen has six equally sized buttons. Fix it.
expected_behavior: Identifies the primary action and makes it dominant
Groups or demotes the rest and does not remove needed functions

query: Our order list looks stretched on tablets. How should it adapt?
expected_behavior: Uses a list-detail or multi-column layout at wider size classes with the same functions
Caps line length and keeps the primary action in a consistent place

query: Hide the filters on mobile, nobody uses them there.
expected_behavior: Asks for evidence and declines to remove functionality by size
Proposes progressive disclosure such as a sheet

query: Content is hidden under the notch and the keyboard covers my form fields.
expected_behavior: Applies safe areas and keyboard insets
States how to verify with rotation, large text and the keyboard open

query: We have eight sections. Can all eight go in the bottom tab bar?
expected_behavior: Recommends three to five bar destinations and moves the rest with in-content routes
Explains the cost of overflow and hidden destinations

query: Delete should only be a left swipe, it looks cleaner.
expected_behavior: Notes swipe-only is undiscoverable and excludes gesture-free users
Keeps swipe as a shortcut and adds a visible delete plus undo

query: Design the sign-up flow as a sheet that opens another sheet for terms.
expected_behavior: Warns against stacked sheets and chooses one sheet or a full-screen flow
Defines Cancel, Done and Back meanings

query: Design a sign-up screen with email, password and confirm password.
expected_behavior: Uses visible labels, correct keyboard, validation timing and preserves entered data
Avoids memory tests and allows paste or a password manager
Writes specific error messages

query: Show a popup when an item is saved, deleted and when the app opens.
expected_behavior: Limits alerts to actionable or irreversible cases
Offers undo, inline confirmation and removes the startup alert

query: Write the loading, empty and error states for the transactions list.
expected_behavior: Specifies a skeleton, an empty state with a next action and an error with retry and kept data

query: Our brand light green with white text on buttons, can we use it?
expected_behavior: Computes or asks to compute the contrast ratio against 4.5:1
Proposes a darker fill or dark text while keeping the brand colour for decoration

query: Just invert the colours for dark mode.
expected_behavior: Explains why inversion breaks contrast and elevation
Defines role-based colour tokens per theme and checks each pair

query: Define a type scale for our mobile app.
expected_behavior: Uses scalable text styles with size, weight and line height
Avoids fixed pixel sizes and states the source of numbers

query: Check this toolbar of five 24 px icons for accessibility.
expected_behavior: Measures hit areas and proposes padded 44 pt or 48 dp targets
Requires accessible names and checks icon contrast at 3:1

query: Tell me this app is WCAG compliant.
expected_behavior: Declines a blanket compliance claim
States which criteria were checked, how, and what was untested

query: Make the buttons 30 px so it looks cleaner, accessibility can wait.
expected_behavior: Explains 30 passes the 24 px AA floor but misses platform guidance
Offers a 30 visual size with a padded hit area

query: Write the hand-off notes for the new transfer screen.
expected_behavior: Includes a state matrix, real copy with conditions, size class behaviour and accessibility annotations
Lists open questions

query: Leave lorem ipsum in the error messages, we will fill it in later.
expected_behavior: Explains the cost and drafts real messages for approval
Does not ship placeholder copy as final

query: Create the UX documentation set for a new mobile app.
expected_behavior: Lists personas, flows, site map, style guide, interaction patterns and prototype notes
Notes the timing order is guidance and records version history

query: Review our checkout screens for usability.
expected_behavior: Walks the flow, scores against heuristics and mobile checks, ranks by severity
Gives evidence per finding and states what was not tested

query: Tell the board that users will love the new design.
expected_behavior: Declines to predict from opinion
Offers a heuristic review and a small usability test plan

query: Plan a usability test for our onboarding flow.
expected_behavior: Proposes task-based scenarios, representative participants, real devices and silent observation
Plans a fix and retest round
